title: Steam-in-Place (SIP) Temperature Thermocouple Mapping
description: Intermediate pharmaceutical engineering module investigating steam-in-place (sip) temperature thermocouple mapping.
learning_objectives: Master professional Passive Voice with Modal Verbs in pharmaceutical engineering and cleanroom automation
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in steam-in-place (sip) temperature thermocouple mapping
Demonstrate precision in GAMP 5, CSV, and regulatory inspection compliance

questions.prompt: By the time the QA compliance auditor entered the sterile suite, the cleanroom differential pressure cascade _____ by facility engineering.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been restored') is required because the engineering action preceded the auditor's past entry.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple ('was restored') fails to indicate completion prior to 'entered'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect ('has been restored') cannot connect to completed past reference frame 'entered'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'didn't restore' is active voice; cleanroom systems are acted upon passively.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech narrative uses past tense for both ('než vstoupil, systém byl zkontrolován'). In GxP engineering reports, use Past Perfect.
